intro.text: A fictional noblewoman in the historical drama Seasons of Regret, a hion viewer program.

items.text: Lady Hinobi, drawn in magenta hion lines, loves the ronin Sir Ashinata but is forbidden to be with him.
After they first kissed, Ashinata told her he must leave forever because of a danger his late, wicked brother had set in motion. A surprise final episode brought him back to her.
